Welcome to CityLights

CityLights is the new portal for visitors and residents. Find out what is on, book tickets, and get the latest news from around the city. Our editors collect the most important stories every day, and our partners in the city council keep the information about road works, public transport, and opening hours up to date. You can browse the latest headlines, read about upcoming concerts and exhibitions, and plan your weekend with our guides to parks, museums, and restaurants. Every week we publish interviews with people who live and work here, and we answer questions sent in by readers. If you have a story to share, send it to the newsroom and we will get back to you within a few days.

Elsewhere on the Web

Our sister sites cover the surrounding region, with news about the harbour, the airport, and the countryside. They share the same account, so you can sign in once and read everything. The regional weather service publishes daily forecasts, and the tourism office lists guided walks and bicycle tours for every season. Local sports clubs post their fixtures and results, and the library announces readings, workshops, and exhibitions for children and adults. For families moving to the area, the welcome centre explains schools, health care, and registration, and its volunteers answer questions in several languages on weekday afternoons and on the first Saturday of every month.
